title: Parking Rate Card Extract: Late Fee Re-Collected by a Bluegate AutoPay Authorization Parking Catch-Up
content:
The parking late fee counted in the parking catch-up amount on a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement drafted under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization is, **where a late fee is posted for the returned parking due date**: the **maximum late fee** when the late-fee percentage of rent times the contracted monthly rent, rounded to the cent, is above the maximum late fee; **that percentage amount** when it is above the flat late fee; and the **flat late fee** when it is not. It is **nothing where no late fee is posted** for that due date.

A late fee posted for the returned parking due date is a late fee entry on the parking ledger whose period is the parking agreement's oldest unpaid due date. The figure counted is computed from the parking class figures and the contracted monthly rent:

| Parking class | Flat late fee | Maximum late fee | Late-fee percentage of rent |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Uncovered Car Space | $20.00 | $40.00 | 20% |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | $25.00 | $50.00 | 15% |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | $30.00 | $60.00 | 15% |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | $30.00 | $60.00 | 12% |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | $35.00 | $70.00 | 12% |
| Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage | $35.00 | $75.00 | 10% |

| Late fee posted for the returned parking due date | Percentage of the contracted monthly rent | Counted |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Above the maximum | Maximum late fee |
| Yes | Above the flat fee, not above the maximum | Percentage amount |
| Yes | Not above the flat fee | Flat late fee |
| No | — | Nothing |

**Hypothetical, Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft), late fee posted:** contracted rent $180.00 gives $27.00, not above $30.00: $30.00. Rent $300.00 gives $45.00: $45.00. Rent $400.00 gives $60.00, equal to the maximum and not above it: $60.00. Rent $420.00 gives $63.00: $60.00. With no late fee posted for the returned parking due date: nothing, whatever the rent.
